author: vinichenzo279
quote:
Game mechanics are tedious. Escaping the cops is more of a run around in circles until they cant see u, put on a hat and enter a car. 
Story is boring, no character is interesting or entertaining. Or worse its frustrating to watch, u should skip most cutscenes because most of the characters are very punchable, but the game wont let you.
Driving feels clunky, shooting feels clunkier. Feels like playing underwater, not smooth.
Its also incredibly easy despite that as they give you too much health and refill and invicibility powers you will never need to bother taking cover or thinking strategically just go blasting and youll be fine.
Very buggy, seen many clips thru walls or cars even one during a SCRIPTED CUTSCENE, and also found a softlock where u enter a room which gets locked when ur wanted state changes, which forced a save reboot. Seems unfinished.
Even the precious graphics arent anywhere near as good as they were hyped to be, barely better than gta 5 ive seen gta 5 mods do better. Worse they have these annoying effects which cover the screen when stressed which makes it impossible to see right when ur low health or in a 5 star chase and need to see the most.
The ability to choose what to rob at any time rather than only set heists seems fun at first but highly repetitive, and theres not much uniqueness after a while.
Far too many missions are boring, such as going to a party, watching people talk and act stupid (not funny stupid, annoying stupid), even a clean a delapadated house with Lucias mom mission. The things that wouldve been cutscenes, or dialogues while driving to a location in old gtas are now the gameplay itself.
There is too much standing around doing nothing, or worse doing boring like fixing a leak. Who wants to do the boring parts of real life in a video game instead of the fun parts of a criminal life?
Far too restrictive in terms of freedom of choice, the choice to do things, bad or good, is gone, now u do it their way. Instead u choose between 20 banks to rob but theyre all the same, but u cant shoot up a club, or have sex with a hooker/stripper.
Game seems to constantly "shame" u for playing the old fashioned way, and warns u against killing indisriminantely until u reach irredeemable tier and it finally shuts up. 
The money system is annoying, transferring to bank/savings is awkward, and what is the fun in a savings account which just locks up ur money and takes it.
The radio is insufferable, because the radio conversations is clearly politically biased, gone is the lete make everyone sound stupid days of old, now.. well u can guess. The old comic relief between missions is now a reminder of who and why this franchise was ruined because of.
It is clear that the mindset has changed drastically. It is not unplayable, there are no fun moments in the story, at all, just infuriating ones as the characterd are dislikable, but in free roam it can be fun for a while, but again, almost all the stick ups are copy pastes. 
This game is without a doubt, the greatest downfall **** series, ever. 
Oh and that house at the start u spend time renovating, which i tried to skip all of but was forced to make a coffee table, it blows up anyway it was all for nothing. I guess they at least got that realistic, in gta 7 maybe theyll add a take a piss mechanic where if u hold it in too long u get kidney stones. Too much realisim means too little fun
